comments.author: Moriel
comments.body:
Not really sure where on this site this fits in, but the cap for purchases when leveling purchase skills has been removed. Its no longer rank x 20. Here were my experiences when i was working my spice trade in palma:

Purchase 1: used my base rank 10, bought 200 spice got 30 prof with the 1.5 skill prof in effect

Purchase 2: used a modified rank 10 + 3, and bought 261 spices, got 39 prof, again 1.5 was active

Purchase 3: used the same modified rank 10 + 3, bought 598 spice with the 1.5 active, got 89 prof.

purchase 4: used all my gear and plusses, managed to get r 10 + 9, bought 820 spice, earned 123 prof, and it was during the same 1.5 skill prof event that followed Gran atlas

Not sure when the change hit, could have been with the Gran Atlas, but it seems there is no longer a limit for purchases when you are after prof.
